task.description: The user prompt or task instruction to be processed by the agent.

parameters.description: Optional model tuning parameters such as temperature.

output_format.description: Requested structure or representation for the output.

agent_id.description: The identifier of the agent that generated the response.

agent_name.description: Human-readable name of the executing agent.

status.description: Outcome status of the task execution.

result.description: Generated payload, text content, or structured object.

metadata.description: Execution metadata including model, duration, tokens, etc.

error.description: Error details if status is error or partial.
